dataset: SonifyEarth Three-State Scientific Classification & Sensitivity Dataset
scientific_principle: Silence Isn't Zero — Unobserved intervals, missing orbits, fatal outages, and SAA radiation blinding are classified as UNKNOWN, never equated to zero lightning.

DETECTED.criteria: Confirmed flash passing strict fatal-bit mask ((lightning_flash_alert_flag & 0x55) == 0), ATBD non-glint criteria, and zero overlap with 1-second SAA intervals ((bg_info_external_alert & 0x03) == 0).

OBSERVED_NO_DETECTION.criteria: Valid positive effective observation duration (viewtime_effective_obs > 0.0 s), warning-only alert status ((viewtime_alert_flag & 0x55) == 0), no SAA overlap ((bg_info_external_alert & 0x03) == 0), and zero confirmed flashes.

UNKNOWN.criteria: Insufficient, degraded, or absent observational evidence to confirm either lightning detection or quiet zero-flash surveillance.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_SAA_RADIATION.description: Observation interval or candidate flash overlaps South Atlantic Anomaly (bg_info_external_alert & 0x03 != 0); conservative SonifyEarth policy prevents claiming OBSERVED_NO_DETECTION or unverified DETECTED.

FATAL_QUALITY_FLAG.description: Record or interval carries an active fatal status bit ((alert_flag & 0x55) != 0), including contiguous hardware outages omitted from viewtime and Class 1 framing-toggle flashes.

MISSING_SOURCE_DATA.description: Query interval falls within the documented 185.78-minute gap on 2023-11-11 where NASA QC removed noisy orbits 20231111_085535_NQC and 20231111_102828_NQC.

OUTSIDE_OBSERVATION_COVERAGE.description: Location lies outside the instantaneous ~550 km ISS LIS FOV swath or poleward of the observed [-55.75 deg, +55.25 deg] orbital latitude envelope.
OUTSIDE_OBSERVATION_COVERAGE.note: Even within [-55.75 deg, +55.25 deg], any cell is OUTSIDE_OBSERVATION_COVERAGE whenever the ISS swath is not overhead.

UNRESOLVED_TIME_MATCH.description: Timestamp falls outside the 7-day mission dataset bounds (before 2023-11-09T22:52:12.400Z or after permanent instrument power-down at 2023-11-16T21:17:00.000Z).

decision_3_effective_observation_sensiti.scientific_justification: Minimum viewtime_effective_obs in the dataset is 0.040 s (20 CCD frames at 500 Hz). Using > 0.0 s preserves 100% of genuine swath perimeter observations, whereas > 0.1 s and > 1.0 s arbitrarily reclassify 343,630 (8.59%) and 696,084 (17.40%) valid clean swath-edge cell passes to UNKNOWN.
